faqs.question: How do I change the font size of text when I print from software in Windows?
faqs.answer: You need to select the text or font size in the software you are printing from, not the printer driver. For detailed instructions, contact the company for the application you are printing from.

faqs.question: Does OS X support manual duplex printing with my product?
faqs.answer: This feature is not supported in Mac OS X. However, if your printer has a built-in automatic duplexer, auto-duplexing is supported in Mac OS X 10.6 (Snow Leopard).

faqs.question: My product is out of color ink even though I print in black only. Why does this happen?
faqs.answer:
To keep the print head clear, the printer uses a small amount of ink from all the cartridges whenever it prints. Even if you select
Black Only
, some color ink is still being used.

faqs.question: I am unable to connect my product to a wireless network. What should I do?
faqs.answer: The printer does not come with built-in wireless features and does not support a wireless (or Ethernet) connection to a network router. Only a direct wired connection to the computer is supported.

faqs.question: My printout is blurry or smeared. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure your paper isn't damp, curled, or loaded face down (the printable side should be loaded face up). Try using Automatic mode. Use a support sheet with special paper or film, or try loading it one sheet at a time. Run the Print Head Alignment utility. Make sure the print head nozzles are not clogged. If you're using the automatic document feeder, try cleaning the paper path guide. Follow the instructions in "Cleaning the Paper Path Guide" in your user's manual. Check the paper thickness switch position. If it's in the + position, your printer is set for thicker paper or envelopes and your image may smear. For most papers, set the paper thickness switch to the 0 position. Make sure your Media Type setting matches the paper you're using. See "Choosing the Right Settings for EPSON Papers" in your user's manual for guidelines. For the best printouts, use EPSON papers and other media.

faqs.question: My printout has lines running through it. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the print head nozzles are not clogged. Run the Print Head Alignment utility. See "Aligning the Print Head" in your user's manual for instructions. Make sure the printable side of the paper is face up. It is usually whiter or shinier. Don't use the High Speed setting. Set the paper thickness switch to the 0 position. Place the EPSON Stylus Scan on a stable, level surface. Make sure none of the five rubber feet is missing from the bottom of the EPSON Stylus Scan.

faqs.question: The printout is faint or has gaps. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the print head nozzles are not clogged. Check the Ink Out LED's on the front panel for a low ink indication; see "Replacing an Ink Cartridge in your user's manual. Make sure the Media Type setting matches the paper you're using. Make sure your paper isn't damaged, old, dirty, or loaded face down. Try using Automatic mode.

faqs.question: Does OS X support manual duplex printing with my product?
faqs.answer: This feature is not supported in Mac OS X. However, if your printer has a built-in automatic duplexer, auto-duplexing is supported in Mac OS X 10.6 (Snow Leopard).

faqs.question: I'm having paper feed problems. What should I do?
faqs.answer: If your EPSON Stylus Scan doesn't feed paper, feeds multiple Pages, or paper is jammed, removed the jammed paper, then remove and replace the stack of paper. Finally, press the load/eject button. Make sure of the following: Paper isn't old, creased, damp, or too thin. The edge guide is resting against the stack of paper. Paper isn't loaded above the arrow on the edge guide. If paper doesn't eject fully, you may have set the wrong paper size. Press the load/eject button to eject the paper. Then make sure you select the correct paper size in your application or print settings. Fan the stack of paper and then even the edges before loading it. Make sure your EPSON Stylus Scan is on a stable, level surface. Check for missing rubber feet on the bottom of the unit.

Place the EPSON Stylus Scan on a stable, level surface. Make sure none of the five rubber feet is missing from the bottom of the EPSON Stylus Scan.

faqs.question: My printout has incorrect or missing colors. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the Ink setting is set to Color for color images. Make sure the print head nozzles are not clogged. If you are printing a high-resolution image, try turning off PhotoEnhance. Try using Automatic mode. See "Basic Printing with Windows" in your user's manual or "Basic Printing on a Macintosh" for instructions.

faqs.question: My product sounds as though it is printing, but nothing prints. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the print head nozzles are not clogged. To run a cleaning cycle, see "Cleaning the Print Head" in your user's manual.

faqs.question: Why are my color documents printing in black and white?
faqs.answer: Make sure your printer and port are selected in your software application. Make sure color printing is selected in your application and the printer software.

faqs.question: My printout is grainy when I print from any application. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Try using a higher quality paper. Run the Print Head Alignment utility. You may need to increase the image resolution or print it in a smaller size. See your software documentation for instructions.

faqs.question: My product is printing blank pages from Windows or my Mac. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the EPSON Stylus Scan 2000 is selected in your application. Also, if you're running Windows, make sure it's selected as the Windows default printer. If you have a Macintosh, select SS 2000 in the Chooser. Make sure you have selected the correct paper size. Make sure the print head nozzles are not clogged.

faqs.question: The printout has a slight slant. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the original document is positioned so that the document guides fit snugly against the edges of the original document. If you're using EPSON Smart Panel's Copy Utility (Windows), select Straighten Only in the Automatic Photo Layout box.

faqs.question: The image quality is poor. What should I do?
faqs.answer: If you're scanning or copying a photograph using EPSON Smart Panel make sure you select Photo as your Scan Material or Document Type. If you're using EPSON TWAIN, select Color Photo (or Black & White Photo if your photo is black and white) as your Image Type. Adjust your Quality and Resolution settings. If you're using EPSON TWAIN to copy a photograph, use the EPSON Photo Paper in your Media Pack for best print quality. Local copy prints at 360 dpi so plain paper is sufficient.

faqs.question: Something is missing or incorrect in the image. What should I do?
faqs.answer: If the scanned image is blank, make sure you feed your page or photo face down. If text is missing or incorrect, try adjusting the scan threshold in the TWAIN window. If you're scanning a document with a lot of graphics, text may not be recognized correctly by the OCR software. If you're using the protection sheet, make sure it isn't dirty or worn out. Make sure your original is straight and the sheet is inserted straight into the scanner. Make sure you select the Quality & de-screening setting in the TWAIN window.

faqs.question: How should I transport my product?
faqs.answer:
For short moves, you can just pick up the EPSON Stylus Scan and set it down. For longer moves, you need to repack it in its original box and lock the print head. Do the following:
1. Press the power button to turn the printer off. Then unplug the power cord and remove the interface cable.
2. Make sure the top cover is closed.
3. Remove all paper and then remove the paper and document supports.
4. Make sure the output tray is lowered, then open the front cover.
5. Secure the ink cartridge holder with tape, as shown.
6. Close the cover and raise the tray.
7. Use the original box and packing materials to repack the printer.
8. Keep the EPSON Stylus Scan level during transport.

faqs.question: The Operate light does not turn on. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the power cable is correctly plugged into the EPSON Stylus Scan and the power outlet. Make sure the outlet is operational and is not connected to a timer or switch.

faqs.question: Only the Operate light is on, but nothing prints. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Turn off the EPSON Stylus Scan and your computer. Make sure the interface cable is connected securely. (Use a fully shielded USB "AB" interface cable or an IEEE-1284 compliant parallel cable.) Make sure there's no packing material inside the EPSON Stylus Scan. Run a printer check as described your user's manual. If you ran a printer check successfully, make sure your EPSON Stylus Scan and application software are installed correctly. If you're printing on a network, you may need to set up your EPSON Stylus Scan for network printing, as described in your electronic EPSON Stylus Scan 2000 Reference Guide.
